findings.reason: the node will implement the criterion as written and silently remove roughly 150 non-browser tests from the standing suite; the criterion must be narrowed to the tests that actually reach the harness, or the coverage loss made an explicit decision.
findings.text: §7 marks "every test in a module that imports tests/spa_browser_harness.py", but §2 defines the browser population as "the tests reaching installed_browser_or_skip" (56 ids, §7's own preamble); 34 files reference the harness (33 test modules) and together they hold ~205 test functions, so the marked set is a large superset of the population — tests/test_build.py alone defines 24 tests and only 9 use the browser fixture `rendered_browser` (line 225, where `installed_browser_or_skip` is called by that module-scoped fixture) — and the standing-suite command excluding the marker would drop ~150 non-browser tests from the standing suite, not the 56 browser ids
